| **Do not standardize case** | Preserve the original capitalization of text entries. | No case inconsistencies were identified. |
| **Do not parse dates** | Keep date columns in their current string format. | The dataset did not indicate any date parsing problems. |
| **Do not drop empty columns** | Keep all columns, even if they contain only missing values. | No empty columns were found. |
